name: trace
description: Trace — a timestamped record of your moments. Monorepo runner for the Express API (backend/) and the React web client (frontend/).

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "api,web" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend ci --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend ci --include=dev
